company: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX)
job_title: Head/Lead of IT Service Operation Management
industry: Financial Services / Capital Markets Exchange Technology
role_summary: Lead HKEX's enterprise IT Service Operation Management (SOM) function, driving ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset/Configuration, Knowledge and Identity Governance processes across a hybrid IT estate. Own the strategy and roadmap to modernize ITSM toward AIOps, predictive analytics, and agentic automation, while managing stakeholder relationships, financials, and team development.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years in Service Management, IT Operations, or Infrastructure leadership
Experience in financial institutions, global MNCs, or enterprise-scale technology organizations
Strong ITSM expertise across Service Design and Service Operation (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge)
Experience with Account Management Lifecycle, Privileged Access Management, and Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes
Experience with hybrid infrastructure: on-prem, cloud, containers, SaaS
Strong understanding of SLA/OLA/SLI management and regulatory compliance
Exposure to SRE, DevOps, or AIOps transformation programs
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related discipline
Proven leadership managing diverse teams and stakeholder relationships at executive and operational levels
Accountability for IT financial management (budget, CAPEX/OPEX, headcount forecasting)
nice_to_have_requirements: ServiceNow platform experience (CIS-SM, CIS-CMDB, CSA, CAD certifications)
Experience with Digital Certificate Management solution implementation
Experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and IGA processes
Experience with Chinese domestic vendor products
Exposure to AI/agentic automation or data intelligence initiatives in IT operations
soft_skills_priority: Analytical problem-solving and willingness to challenge status quo

scoring_criteria.name: ITSM Process Leadership Depth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core of the role is owning enterprise ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge) at scale.

scoring_criteria.name: Identity & Access Governance Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly requires strong Account Management Lifecycle, PAM, and JML process expertise.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Many ITSM leaders lack deep IGA/PAM specialization

scoring_criteria.name: Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud Exposure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Operations span on-prem, cloud, containers, and SaaS environments requiring cross-platform fluency.

scoring_criteria.name: AIOps / Automation & Modernization Vision
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role demands driving transformation from traditional ITSM to AI-driven, automated service operations.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Agentic AI in ITSM is emerging; limited real-world case studies expected

scoring_criteria.name: Financial & Resource Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Accountable for IT budget, CAPEX/OPEX, and headcount planning for the function.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder & Executive Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires strong engagement with business and IT executives on service risks, changes, and improvements.

scoring_criteria.name: Regulatory & Compliance Awareness (Financial Sector)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: HKEX operates in a highly regulated capital markets environment requiring strict compliance controls.

scoring_criteria.name: Tooling & Platform Expertise (ServiceNow, Monitoring, Ansible)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Specific tool experience (ServiceNow CIS-SM/CMDB, Ansible, monitoring platforms) is explicitly listed as advantageous.

scoring_criteria.name: Team Leadership & Talent Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires coaching diverse teams and building organizational capability.

scoring_criteria.name: Educational & Professional Certification Fit
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Baseline qualification requirement; certifications add credibility for enterprise ITSM leadership.

summary_focus: Position as enterprise ITSM/Service Operations leader with 10+ years driving process, governance, and automation maturity
Highlight experience across Incident/Problem/Change/Request/Knowledge/Asset management at scale
Emphasize hybrid infrastructure exposure (cloud, on-prem, SaaS) and AIOps/automation transformation initiatives
Showcase stakeholder engagement, financial accountability, and team leadership in regulated or enterprise environments
Mention any identity governance, PAM, or ServiceNow platform experience explicitly
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct agentic AI implementation unless proven with specific project evidence
Do not overstate SailPoint ISC or IGA expertise if only exposure-level experience exists
Avoid implying regulatory financial exchange experience if not previously in banking/capital markets sector
Do not inflate team size or budget scope beyond documented facts

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Confident, strategic, and operationally credible — reflecting a senior IT service leader comfortable engaging both executives and technical teams
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Present candidate as a transformation-oriented Service Operations leader capable of modernizing ITSM through automation, AIOps, and governance discipline within a regulated financial or enterprise context
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking direct capital markets experience, emphasize enterprise-scale or regulated industry equivalence (banking, insurance, MNC IT operations)
If limited hands-on AIOps/agentic AI experience, highlight automation-first mindset and readiness to lead adoption
If IGA/PAM exposure is partial, frame as familiarity with identity lifecycle governance principles and cross-team collaboration with IAM teams
